dialogue.speaker: Sister
dialogue.text: What are you making for breakfast? It smells cozy.

dialogue.speaker: Brother
dialogue.text: I am preparing a warm bowl of oatmeal. It is very nutritious.

dialogue.speaker: Sister
dialogue.text: Nice! What kind of topping do you have?

dialogue.speaker: Brother
dialogue.text: I slice some fresh bananas and sprinkle chia seeds on top.

dialogue.speaker: Sister
dialogue.text: That is perfect. It gives you plenty of fiber for the whole morning.

story.text: A young man makes a nutritious breakfast bowl every morning. He cooks hot oatmeal and adds sliced banana as a sweet topping. He also likes to sprinkle chia seeds over the mixture to get extra fiber for his digestion.

questions.question: What is the main ingredient of the breakfast bowl?
questions.suggested_answer: The main ingredient is oatmeal.

questions.question: What fruit does he use as a topping?
questions.suggested_answer: He uses sliced bananas.

questions.question: What does he sprinkle on top of the food?
questions.suggested_answer: He sprinkles chia seeds.

questions.question: What nutrient does this meal provide in high amounts?
questions.suggested_answer: It provides plenty of fiber.

dialogue.speaker: Senior Dev
dialogue.text: Your computer screen has too much clutter. It slows down your workflow.

dialogue.speaker: Junior Dev
dialogue.text: Yeah, I just save every download file directly to the desktop.

dialogue.speaker: Senior Dev
dialogue.text: You should create a separate folder for each active project.

dialogue.speaker: Junior Dev
dialogue.text: Good point. I will sort them by category and archive the old ones.

dialogue.speaker: Senior Dev
dialogue.text: Don't forget to run a cloud backup when you finish organizing.

story.text: A developer cleans his computer workspace to remove digital clutter. He creates a specific folder for every new project and learns to sort his assets efficiently. Finally, he decides to archive expired contracts and performs a secure database backup.

questions.question: What problem does the computer screen have?
questions.suggested_answer: It has too much digital clutter.

questions.question: What tool does the developer create to organize files?
questions.suggested_answer: He creates a specific folder for each project.

questions.question: How does he manage old, completed files?
questions.suggested_answer: He decides to archive them.

questions.question: What safety action does he perform at the end?
questions.suggested_answer: He performs a secure backup.

Nhiên liệu, xăng dầu

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.text: Hi, I would like to inquire about your scooter rental price per day.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Hello! It is fifteen dollars per day. Do you have a international driving license?

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.text: Yes, here is my license and my passport for the deposit.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Perfect. The vehicle has a full tank of fuel. Here is your safety helmet.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.text: Thank you. I am ready to explore the coastal roads.

story.text: A tourist visits a local shop to arrange a vehicle rental for the weekend. He shows his driving license and leaves a small cash deposit at the desk. The shop owner gives him a clean helmet and reminds him that the scooter already contains fuel.

questions.question: What kind of vehicle does the tourist rent?
questions.suggested_answer: He rents a scooter.

questions.question: What document must he show to the agent?
questions.suggested_answer: He must show his driving license.

questions.question: What safety gear does the shop provide?
questions.suggested_answer: The shop provides a safety helmet.

questions.question: Is the scooter empty of fuel?
questions.suggested_answer: No, it already contains a full tank of fuel.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague A
dialogue.text: Ouch! I just got a nasty paper cut from these document folders.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague B
dialogue.text: Oh, does it bleed a lot? Let me look at your index finger.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague A
dialogue.text: Not too much, but it really starts to sting when I type.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague B
dialogue.text: Wash it first. I have some antiseptic ointment and a clean adhesive bandage in my desk.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague A
dialogue.text: Thanks, putting the bandage on helps protect it from dust.

story.text: An office worker gets a minor paper cut on his finger while organizing files. The tiny scratch begins to bleed and sting during work. He applies an antiseptic ointment immediately and covers the area with a small adhesive bandage.

questions.question: How does the employee hurt his finger?
questions.suggested_answer: He gets a minor paper cut from document folders.

questions.question: What uncomfortable sensation does he feel?
questions.suggested_answer: The cut begins to sting.

questions.question: What type of cream does he apply to prevent infection?
questions.suggested_answer: He applies an antiseptic ointment.

questions.question: What does he wrap around his finger?
questions.suggested_answer: He wraps a small adhesive bandage around it.

dialogue.speaker: Wife
dialogue.text: The bathroom sink faucet continues to drip all night long. It keeps me awake.

dialogue.speaker: Husband
dialogue.text: I see it. The rubber washer inside is probably broken or worn out.

dialogue.speaker: Wife
dialogue.text: Do we need to call a professional plumber to handle it?

dialogue.speaker: Husband
dialogue.text: No, I can do it myself. I just need a heavy wrench to loosen the metal pipe.

dialogue.speaker: Wife
dialogue.text: Okay, change the washer and make sure to tighten the nut firmly.

story.text: A homeowner notices that his kitchen sink faucet starts to drip continuously. Instead of calling an expensive plumber, he uses his own metal wrench to open the pipe. He replaces the old rubber washer and uses force to tighten the joint.

questions.question: What annoying sound comes from the sink?
questions.suggested_answer: The faucet drips continuously.

questions.question: Who does the wife suggest calling?
questions.suggested_answer: She suggests calling a professional plumber.

questions.question: What tool does the husband use to open the pipe?
questions.suggested_answer: He uses a metal wrench.

questions.question: What small part needs replacement inside the faucet?
questions.suggested_answer: The old rubber washer needs replacement.

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.text: I have nothing to watch tonight. Can you recommend a good thriller?

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.text: You must check out 'The Hidden Room'. The final plot twist blows my mind!

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.text: Oh, really? Does it get a positive review from critics?

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.text: Yes, the critics love it. The lead actor's acting is powerful and intense.

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.text: Awesome. I love cinema masterpieces. I will stream it right now.

story.text: A film fan loves to recommend great cinema projects to his friends. He talks about a new thriller movie because the final plot twist is incredible. He explains that every online review praises the high-quality acting, making it a true masterpiece.

questions.question: What film genre does Friend A request?
questions.suggested_answer: He requests a good thriller movie.

questions.question: What specific feature makes the movie special according to Friend B?
questions.suggested_answer: The final plot twist makes it special.

questions.question: What is the general feedback in the public review?
questions.suggested_answer: The reviews are highly positive and praise the film.

questions.question: How is the performance of the actors described?
questions.suggested_answer: The acting is described as powerful and intense.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Excuse me, my laptop screen suddenly blinks. Is it covered under warranty?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.text: Let me check your purchase receipt. It has a two-year warranty coverage.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Great, I bought it last year, so the coverage is not expired yet.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.text: Yes, if the blinking is a manufacturing defect, the store fixes it for free.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Perfect, how long does the screen repair process take?

story.text: A customer brings his blinking laptop to the service counter to check the warranty terms. The store agent confirms that the hardware coverage remains active and is not expired. Since the screen issue is a factory defect, the service center schedules a free repair.

questions.question: What device needs inspection?
questions.suggested_answer: A laptop needs inspection.

questions.question: Is the laptop's warranty period expired?
questions.suggested_answer: No, the warranty coverage is not expired yet.

questions.question: Under what condition is the repair completely free?
questions.suggested_answer: It is free if the issue is a manufacturing defect.

questions.question: What service action does the technician schedule?
questions.suggested_answer: He schedules a technical repair.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: Good evening, Skyline Bistro. How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Hi, I want to book a table for a party of four people tonight around 7 PM.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: Let me look at the map. The indoor section is fully booked, but we have outdoor tables.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Can we request an outdoor window seat with the city view?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: Yes, we have one available. Let me confirm your name and phone number.

story.text: A customer calls a popular bistro to book a dining table for his family. The receptionist states that the indoor lounge is fully booked for the night. However, she manages to confirm a beautiful outdoor window seat for their specific party.

questions.question: How many people are in the dining party?
questions.suggested_answer: There are four people in the party.

questions.question: What is the situation with the indoor dining room?
questions.suggested_answer: The indoor section is completely fully booked.

questions.question: What specific seating request does the customer make?
questions.suggested_answer: He requests a window seat with a view.

questions.question: What does the receptionist do after taking the details?
questions.suggested_answer: She confirms the final reservation.

dialogue.text: Let's gather around the whiteboard to brainstorm marketing ideas for the app.

dialogue.speaker: Designer
dialogue.text: I have a fresh concept involving retro pixel art illustrations.

dialogue.speaker: Team Lead
dialogue.text: That sounds highly innovative! Let me write that down on the board.

dialogue.speaker: Developer
dialogue.text: My feedback is positive, but we must ensure it looks good on small phone screens.

dialogue.speaker: Team Lead
dialogue.text: Agreed. Let's gather more detailed feedback from testing users later.

story.text: The creative department meets in the office to brainstorm launch strategies. The team lead uses a large whiteboard to record every innovative design suggestion. A designer introduces a retro graphic concept, and colleagues share constructive feedback.

questions.question: Why does the team gather together?
questions.suggested_answer: They gather to brainstorm marketing ideas.

questions.question: What office object does the lead use to record notes?

questions.question: How does the lead describe the pixel art suggestion?

questions.question: What do the colleagues provide after a concept is shared?

dialogue.speaker: Passenger A
dialogue.text: Listen! There is an official airport announcement playing over the speaker.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger B
dialogue.text: Oh no, bad weather causes a heavy three-hour delay for our flight.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger A
dialogue.text: This delay will completely annihilate our tight connection schedule in Tokyo.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger B
dialogue.text: Let's go to the airline customer service desk. Maybe they can give us a business lounge pass.

dialogue.speaker: Passenger A
dialogue.text: Good idea, waiting inside the lounge is much better than sitting at the gate.

story.text: A sudden thunderstorm creates a massive schedule delay at the terminal. A loud voice announcement informs travelers about the heavy rain. The unexpected change threatens to annihilate a passenger's connection flight, so he goes to wait inside the quiet lounge.

questions.question: What causes the flight schedule disruption?
questions.suggested_answer: A sudden thunderstorm and bad weather cause it.

questions.question: How long is the official time delay?
questions.suggested_answer: The delay lasts for three hours.

questions.question: What critical plan does the delay threaten to annihilate?
questions.suggested_answer: It threatens to annihilate the tight connection flight schedule.

questions.question: Where do the passengers decide to rest during the wait?
questions.suggested_answer: They decide to rest inside the airport lounge.
